description: A short, thick blade with a blunt prying tip and a grip moulded for a gloved hand, coated against salt. Tidewell built it for cutting yourself out of a net at four metres, which is a specific way of saying it holds an edge when the rest of your kit has turned to rust.
name: Tidewell diving knife
